ireland-mens.name: Ireland Men's Senior
ireland-mens.pubNote: Ireland home games at Aviva are pub-friendly. Away Six Nations games kick off midday–evening Irish time — pub-friendly. Autumn internationals depend on the opponent's timezone.

ireland-womens.name: Ireland Women's Senior
ireland-womens.pubNote: Women's Six Nations fixtures kick off midday–evening Irish time — pub-friendly. Women's RWC in Australia (2027) likely morning Irish time.

ireland-u20-mens.name: Ireland U20 Men
ireland-u20-mens.pubNote: U20 Six Nations kick off midday–evening Irish time. U20 World Cup in Argentina (2026) — afternoon Irish time, pub-watchable.

ireland-u20-womens.name: Ireland U20 Women
ireland-u20-womens.pubNote: U20 Women's Six Nations kick off midday–evening Irish time.

ireland-sevens.name: Ireland Sevens
ireland-sevens.pubNote: Sevens World Series stop in Dublin is pub-friendly. Sevens World Cup in 2025/2026 — depends on host.

south-africa-mens.name: South Africa Men's Senior
south-africa-mens.pubNote: Springboks play in the Rugby Championship (Southern Hemisphere) — evening local kick-offs are morning Irish time. World Cup pool games in Southern Hemisphere = morning Irish time.

new-zealand-mens.name: New Zealand Men's Senior
new-zealand-mens.pubNote: All Blacks play in the Rugby Championship — evening local kick-offs are morning Irish time. Northern Hemisphere tours fall in Irish afternoon/evening — pub-friendly.

australia-mens.name: Australia Men's Senior
australia-mens.pubNote: Wallabies play in the Rugby Championship — evening local (east coast) = morning Irish time. 2027 RWC home games = morning Irish time (final 13 Nov 2027 ~9am Irish).

argentina-mens.name: Argentina Men's Senior
argentina-mens.pubNote: Los Pumas play in the Rugby Championship — evening local = early morning Irish time. 2026 U20 World Cup in Argentina — afternoon Irish time, pub-watchable.

france-mens.name: France Men's Senior
france-mens.pubNote: France in Six Nations — away games in Ireland kick off midday–evening Irish time (pub-friendly). France home games = morning Irish time (1–2 hours ahead) — pub-friendly if up early.

england-mens.name: England Men's Senior
england-mens.pubNote: England in Six Nations — away games in Ireland kick off midday–evening Irish time (pub-friendly). England home games = morning Irish time (1 hour ahead) — pub-friendly if up early.

scotland-mens.name: Scotland Men's Senior
scotland-mens.pubNote: Scotland in Six Nations — away games in Ireland kick off midday–evening Irish time (pub-friendly). Scotland home games = morning Irish time (same timezone in winter, 1 hour ahead in summer) — pub-friendly.

wales-mens.name: Wales Men's Senior
wales-mens.pubNote: Wales in Six Nations — away games in Ireland kick off midday–evening Irish time (pub-friendly). Wales home games = morning Irish time (1 hour ahead in summer, same in winter) — pub-friendly.

italy-mens.name: Italy Men's Senior
italy-mens.pubNote: Italy in Six Nations — away games in Ireland kick off midday–evening Irish time (pub-friendly). Italy home games = morning Irish time (1 hour ahead) — pub-friendly if up early.

japan-mens.name: Japan Men's Senior
japan-mens.pubNote: Japan is 8–9 hours ahead of Ireland — morning Irish time for evening local kick-offs. 2019 RWC host. Watch at home, meet later.

georgia-mens.name: Georgia Men's Senior
georgia-mens.pubNote: Georgia is 2–3 hours ahead of Ireland — morning Irish time for evening local kick-offs. Rugby Europe Championship. Watch at home, meet later.

fiji-mens.name: Fiji Men's Senior
fiji-mens.pubNote: Fiji is 10–12 hours ahead of Ireland — early morning Irish time for evening local kick-offs. Pacific Nations Cup. Watch at home, meet later.

samoa-mens.name: Samoa Men's Senior
samoa-mens.pubNote: Samoa is 10–12 hours ahead of Ireland — early morning Irish time for evening local kick-offs. Watch at home, meet later.

tonga-mens.name: Tonga Men's Senior
tonga-mens.pubNote: Tonga is 10–12 hours ahead of Ireland — early morning Irish time for evening local kick-offs. Watch at home, meet later.

england-womens.name: England Women's Senior
england-womens.pubNote: England Women in Women's Six Nations — away games in Ireland kick off midday–evening Irish time (pub-friendly).

france-womens.name: France Women's Senior
france-womens.pubNote: France Women in Women's Six Nations — away games in Ireland kick off midday–evening Irish time (pub-friendly).

scotland-womens.name: Scotland Women's Senior
scotland-womens.pubNote: Scotland Women in Women's Six Nations — away games in Ireland kick off midday–evening Irish time (pub-friendly).

wales-womens.name: Wales Women's Senior
wales-womens.pubNote: Wales Women in Women's Six Nations — away games in Ireland kick off midday–evening Irish time (pub-friendly).

italy-womens.name: Italy Women's Senior
italy-womens.pubNote: Italy Women in Women's Six Nations — away games in Ireland kick off midday–evening Irish time (pub-friendly).

new-zealand-womens.name: New Zealand Women's Senior
new-zealand-womens.pubNote: Black Ferns — evening local kick-offs are morning Irish time. 2027 RWC in Australia likely morning Irish time.

australia-womens.name: Australia Women's Senior
australia-womens.pubNote: Wallaroos — evening local (east coast) = morning Irish time. 2027 RWC in Australia likely morning Irish time.

south-africa-womens.name: South Africa Women's Senior
south-africa-womens.pubNote: Springbok Women — evening local kick-offs are morning Irish time.

argentina-womens.name: Argentina Women's Senior
argentina-womens.pubNote: Las Pumas — evening local kick-offs are early morning Irish time.

leinster.name: Leinster
leinster.pubNote: Leinster home games at Aviva are pub-friendly. European away games in France/England/Italy/Scotland/Wales kick off in Irish afternoon — pub-friendly. URC away games in South Africa/Argentina are early morning Irish time.

munster.name: Munster
munster.pubNote: Munster home games at Thomond Park are pub-friendly (Limerick pubs). European away games kick off in Irish afternoon — pub-friendly in Dublin if you're watching remotely.

ulster.name: Ulster
ulster.pubNote: Ulster home games at Ravenhill are pub-friendly. Away European games in France/England/Italy/Scotland/Wales kick off in Irish afternoon — pub-friendly in Dublin.

connacht.name: Connacht
connacht.pubNote: Connacht home games at Atlantic Park are pub-friendly. Away European games in France/England/Italy/Scotland/Wales kick off in Irish afternoon — pub-friendly in Dublin.

six-nations.name: Six Nations
six-nations.format: Round robin (home and away over two years for full double round robin every two years, single round robin in off years)
six-nations.pubNote: Away games kick off midday–evening Irish time — pub-friendly. Home games at Aviva are in Dublin pubs.

womens-six-nations.name: Women's Six Nations
womens-six-nations.pubNote: Away games kick off midday–evening Irish time — pub-friendly. Ireland home games at Aviva/USW are pub-friendly.

rugby-world-cup.name: Rugby World Cup
rugby-world-cup.season: Every four years. 2023 in France. 2027 in Australia.
rugby-world-cup.pubNote: Pool games against touring sides in Southern Hemisphere = morning Irish time (watch at home, meet later). Ireland home games/pub-friendly. Final 13 Nov 2027 Sydney ~9am Irish time — early morning pub possible.

womens-rugby-world-cup.name: Women's Rugby World Cup
womens-rugby-world-cup.Season: Every four years. 2025 in England. 2027 in Ireland (hosts: Ireland, together with Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland).
womens-rugby-world-cup.pubNote: If 2027 is hosted in Ireland, all Ireland games are in Irish time and pub-friendly. If elsewhere, depends on timezone.

urc.name: United Rugby Championship
urc.pubNote: Most URC games kick off in Irish time (afternoon/evening). Away games in South Africa/Argentina = early morning Irish time.

european-champions-cup.name: European Champions Cup
european-champions-cup.teams: Top URC and other European league teams qualify.
european-champions-cup.pubNote: Champions Cup games usually kick off in the afternoon local time = morning Irish time for away games in France/England/Italy/Scotland/Wales — pub-friendly if you're up early. Final usually evening Irish time.

european-challenge-cup.name: European Challenge Cup
european-challenge-cup.teams: Wider set of teams qualify than Champions Cup.
european-challenge-cup.pubNote: Similar kick-off pattern to Champions Cup — morning Irish time for away games in Western Europe, pub-friendly if you're up early.

rugby-championship.name: Rugby Championship
rugby-championship.pubNote: Southern Hemisphere tournament — evening local kick-offs are early morning Irish time. Watch at home, meet later. Northern Hemisphere touring sides in Irish summer fall in Irish afternoon/evening — pub-friendly.

sevens-world-series.name: Sevens World Series
sevens-world-series.pubNote: Dublin Sevens stop is pub-friendly. Away stops in Europe (Paris, London, etc.) are morning Irish time — pub-friendly if up early. Stops in Asia/Americas are early morning Irish time.

sevens-world-cup.name: Rugby World Cup Sevens
sevens-world-cup.season: Every four years. 2025 in Saudi Arabia.
sevens-world-cup.pubNote: Saudi Arabia — evening local time = early morning Irish time.

world-cup-sevens-womens.name: Women's Sevens World Cup
world-cup-sevens-womens.pubNote: Same timezone logic as men's Sevens World Cup.

world-cup-2027.name: Rugby World Cup 2027
world-cup-2027.pubNote: Australia is 11 hours ahead (east coast) — evening Australian kick-off = morning Irish time. Final 13 Nov 2027, 20:00 AEDT = 9:00am Irish time — early morning pub possible.

leinsterseniorscup.name: Leinster Senior Cup
leinsterseniorscup.pubNote: League games in Irish time. Cup games at various venues — pub-friendly if in Dublin.

munsterseniorscup.name: Munster Senior Cup
munsterseniorscup.pubNote: Games in Munster — Limerick/Cork/Kerry pubs. Dublin pubs if watching remotely.

ulsterseniorscup.name: Ulster Senior Cup
ulsterseniorscup.pubNote: Games in Ulster — Belfast pubs. Dublin pubs if watching remotely.

connaght seniors cup.name: Connacht Senior Cup
connaght seniors cup.pubNote: Games in Connacht — Galway/ROI pubs. Dublin pubs if watching remotely.

pacific-nations-cup.name: Pacific Nations Cup
pacific-nations-cup.pubNote: Pacific teams — evening local kick-offs are early morning Irish time. Watch at home, meet later.

rugby-europe-championship.name: Rugby Europe Championship
rugby-europe-championship.pubNote: Eastern European teams — evening local kick-offs are morning Irish time (1–3 hours ahead). Watch at home, meet later, or pub-friendly if up early.

worldTimezones.description: Kick-off time reference — how local kick-off times translate to Irish time for pub watchability.

zones.note: Same as Irish time. Pub-friendly if kick-off is afternoon/evening local.
1 hour ahead of Irish winter time. Pub-friendly if afternoon/evening local.
1 hour ahead of Irish time. Afternoon/evening local = late afternoon Irish — pub-friendly.

zones.region: Western Europe (France, Spain, Italy — summer, DST)
zones.note: 2 hours ahead. Afternoon local = late afternoon Irish — pub-friendly.
1 hour ahead. Afternoon local = late afternoon Irish — pub-friendly.

zones.region: Central Europe (Germany, Poland, etc. — summer, DST)
zones.note: 2 hours ahead. Afternoon local = late afternoon Irish — pub-friendly.
2–4 hours ahead. Evening local = late evening Irish — pub-friendly if up late. Morning local = early morning Irish.
2 hours ahead. Afternoon/evening local = late afternoon/evening Irish — pub-friendly.
3 hours behind. Afternoon/evening local = morning Irish — pub-friendly if early. Morning local = very early Irish.
12–13 hours ahead. Evening local = morning Irish — watch at home, meet later.
10 hours ahead. Evening local = morning Irish — watch at home, meet later. 2027 RWC final 20:00 AEDT = 9:00am Irish.
8 hours ahead. Evening local = early morning Irish — watch at home, meet later.
9 hours ahead. Evening local = early morning Irish — watch at home, meet later.
12–14 hours ahead. Evening local = early morning Irish — watch at home, meet later.
